def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    fig=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg]
    if not fig: return grid
    top=min(i for i,_ in fig); bot=max(i for i,_ in fig)
    left=min(j for _,j in fig); right=max(j for _,j in fig)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows_cnt=[sum(1 for j in range(left,right+1) if grid[i][j]!=bg) for i in range(H)]
    cols_cnt=[sum(1 for i in range(top,bot+1) if grid[i][j]!=bg) for j in range(W)]
    for i in range(top,bot+1):
        for j in range(left,right+1):
            if grid[i][j]!=bg: continue
            border = i in (top,bot) or j in (left,right)
            line = rows_cnt[i]>=4 or cols_cnt[j]>=4
            if border or line: out[i][j]=2
    return out
